description:
Drinko helps you make better cocktails at home with classic recipes, bartending tutorials, and a smart cabinet to track ingredients.

Explore 140+ classic cocktail recipes and 40+ shots — from a Negroni and Old Fashioned to a Margarita, Daiquiri, Mojito, and Gin Tonic — learn essential bartending techniques, save your favourites, and see what's already in your home bar and spirits cabinet before you shop.

Make it yours: add your own recipes with a photo, turn it into a sticker, and share any recipe as a card with friends. Your favourites and settings stay in sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac with iCloud.

Drinko is built for beginners and cocktail enthusiasts who want to mix with more confidence, improve their technique, and stay organised behind the bar.
whatsNew:
See what you can mix tonight: What Can I Make? checks your Cabinet and lists every cocktail it covers, plus twists with a spirit you already own.

New
• What Can I Make? shows every cocktail your Cabinet can make right now
• Twists: cocktails you can make by swapping in a spirit you already own
• Switch What Can I Make? between a list and a grid
• A step-by-step guide to adding the Drinko widget, in Settings
• A changelog in Settings shows what's new in every update
• Request a feature right from Settings

Improved
• Your own cocktails now switch units too, and ounces convert to the nearest 5 ml
• The cocktail of the day, on the widget and from Siri, now includes shots
• Delete buttons now appear in your language
promotionalText: Ask Siri how to make a Negroni and Drinko reads the recipe aloud. Get today's cocktail, restock your Cabinet by voice and find any drink in Spotlight.
